decision: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the car has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article B3.5.3 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
reason: Cadillac Formula 1 Team changed the setup of Car 77 under Parc Ferme, without the approval of the Technical Delegate, this not being in accordance with Article B3.5.3 of the FIA F1 Regulations. The F1 car is therefore required to start the Sprint from pit lane as per Article B3.5.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 77 Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, Cadillac Formula 1 Team
